units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:4">B. Bath. IX, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 144b:7">144ᵇ</cite>) <he>האחים שעשו מקצתן ש׳ … חזרה ש׳ וכ׳</he> (Mish. ed. <cite ref="U00565"><he>שׁוֹשְׁבָנוּת</he></cite>) if a part of the brothers have served as somebody’s groomsmen in their father’s lifetime (the gifts having been furnished by the father), the gifts returned (on the occasion of a wedding in their family) go into the common fund of the estate; <he>שהש׳ נגבית בב״ד</he> for the reciprocation of wedding gifts can be legally enforced. Ib. 144ᵇ <he>שלח לו אביו ש׳</he> if the father sent the gifts for him (his son, specifying him as the donor); <he>שלח אביו ש׳ סתם</he> if the father sent the gifts without specifying the donor. Ib. <he>נשתלחה לאביו ש׳</he> if the gifts (in the son’s behalf) were sent in the father’s name; a. e.
